mapper.select: SELECT tx_id, tx_type, payment_id, payment_intent_id, parent_tx_id, acquirer_reference, amount_value, amount_currency, status, settle_status, acquirer_batch_ref, settled_amount_value, created_at FROM payment_tx WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT t.tx_id, t.tx_type, t.payment_id, t.payment_intent_id, t.parent_tx_id, t.acquirer_reference, t.amount_value, t.amount_currency, t.status, t.settle_status, t.acquirer_batch_ref, t.settled_amount_value, t.created_at FROM payment_tx t JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = t.payment_id WHERE t.payment_id = #{paymentId} AND p.merchant_account = #{merchantAccount} ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.tx_id ASC

SELECT t.tx_id, t.tx_type, t.payment_id, t.payment_intent_id, t.parent_tx_id, t.acquirer_reference, t.amount_value, t.amount_currency, t.status, t.settle_status, t.acquirer_batch_ref, t.settled_amount_value, t.created_at FROM payment_tx t JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = t.payment_id WHERE t.tx_id = #{txId} AND p.merchant_account = #{merchantAccount}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_tx ( tx_id, tx_type, payment_id, payment_intent_id, parent_tx_id, acquirer_reference, amount_value, amount_currency, status, settle_status, acquirer_batch_ref, settled_amount_value ) VALUES ( #{txId}, #{txType}, #{paymentId}, #{paymentIntentId}, #{parentTxId}, #{acquirerReference}, #{amountValue}, #{amountCurrency}, #{status}, #{settleStatus}, #{acquirerBatchRef}, #{settledAmountValue} ) ON CONFLICT (tx_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, settle_status = EXCLUDED.settle_status, acquirer_batch_ref = EXCLUDED.acquirer_batch_ref, settled_amount_value = EXCLUDED.settled_amount_value
